text: Describe your thoughts and feelings on an occasion when you were desperate for someone or
something to arrive.
OR
Imagine you are travelling in a cable car which stops unexpectedly. Describe your surroundings
and your thoughts and feelings.
OR
Narrative Writing
You were walking along when someone rushed towards you, asking for help. Write a story which
starts at this point.
OR
Write a story called ‘A Way Out’.
